The Iranian delegation was received by Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif and senior Pakistani officials at Nur Khan Air Base in Rawalpindi. The visit comes as diplomats work to advance the US-Iran agreement and ease tensions across the region. Pakistan has played a key role in facilitating contacts between the two sides, with officials saying work is under way to advance the next phase of negotiations
